description: 3-stage mass assignment via SQLAlchemy JSON column persistence on Stripe payment app: (1) add WebhookConfig model with settings JSON column + GET /webhook/settings for extensible webhook configuration, (2) add PUT /webhook/settings that merges request JSON into settings dict via dict.update -- but changes silently vanish because SQLAlchemy cannot detect in-place JSON mutations, (3) fix persistence with flag_modified('settings') before commit -- now arbitrary user-controlled JSON persists including notify_refunds, max_retry_amount, skip_signature_check fields.
